summary: Strong Modern Age set: the four everyday roles are clearly differentiated, the Mayor's dark suit and gold sash establish authority, and the guide convincingly belongs to the tourist caravan. Mostly retain these designs; headwear visibility and ceremonial/travel prop construction need cleanup.
problems: The library sunhat, maintenance visor and guide's brim obscure most of the eye area at this viewing angle. The worker's broad dark bill reads more like a face shield than a hardhat brim.
The guide's segmented mint brim reads as a square frame around the head rather than one fitted fabric hat.
The Mayor's scissors read as gold loops beneath a single spike, while the ribbon resembles a rigid red baton. These props do not clearly communicate a ribbon-cutting ceremony.
The guide's extended-handle wheeled suitcase hangs above the ground in the shown pose. The map and flag also compete around the same hand.
fix: Plant Keeper: Retain the cream apron, contrasting pocket and chunky plant silhouette; these already communicate the role well. Preserve visible hand-to-pot contact during animation. Canvas-Jacket Neighbour: Retain the jacket, phone and backpack distinction. Make the backpack straps visibly continue over the shoulders into the pack rather than terminate as front strips; keep them seated against the jacket. Sunhat Library Regular: Keep the broad hat, open cardigan, book and tote. Reduce the brim's forward projection and turn its front edge upward enough to expose the eyes at the gameplay camera, without lifting the crown off the head. Town Maintenance Worker: Replace the deep dark visor with a short, thin pale brim and add one chunky crown ridge to establish a safety helmet. Preserve the excellent hi-vis front/back bands and separate toolbox silhouette. Mayor of the Civic Ribbon: Keep the suit and front/back gold sash. Consolidate the small chest pins into one approximately 0.18-wide, blue-centred civic medallion. Rebuild the scissors with two visibly separate silver blades sharing a pivot and two connected handles; give the red ribbon a broad folded section and short hanging tail instead of a straight rod. Far-Routes Tour Guide: Replace the four disconnected-looking brim slabs with a continuous fitted low-poly bucket-hat brim, with a lifted front edge. Keep the flag as the primary overhead identifier and tuck the folded map into a jacket pocket. Lower and constrain the suitcase so its wheels contact the same ground plane as the shoes, adjusting the telescoping handle to meet the hand; do not let it swing rigidly with the arm.
